description_expanded: Perched near the shimmering shoreline of Grayton Beach, Down By The Sea i s a cheerfully updated four-bedroom, four-bath coastal retreat that comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests. From the columned front porch and breezy upper balcony, guests are treated to beautiful views of the Gulf and nearby Western Lake—one of the area’s rare coastal dune lakes found in only a handful of places around the world. This vacation home sits along a pathway that leads toward the lake’s inlet and the sugar-white sand beyond, placing both natural beauty and beach adventures just moments away. Inside, the first floor unfolds into a welcoming open great room where the living, dining, and kitchen spaces flow together beneath rustic wood ceiling beams and warm hardwood flooring. The home has been thoughtfully refreshed with new furnishings, freshly painted interiors, upgraded lighting with dimmers, and wall-mounted Smart TVs in every bedroom, creating a bright and comfortable setting for gathering together. A spacious wraparound sofa and a queen sleeper sofa with soft seafoam slipcovers provide inviting seating oriented toward the large glass doors and the scenic views outside. The gourmet kitchen has been recently fully renovated and now features an oversized quartz island, custom cabinetry, a Wolf gas range, and premium Sub-Zero appliances. Fully stocked for those who enjoy cooking, this beautifully designed space makes it easy to prepare everything from casual breakfasts to coastal feasts. The adjacent dining area includes a hardwood table with eight cross-backed chairs beneath a warm Edison-style chandelier, while a nearby custom-built cabinet serves as a convenient entertaining station complete with an undercounter Sub-Zero beer and wine refrigerator. The main level also includes a guest bedroom with both a queen and a full bed, along with a nearby hall bath featuring a glass walk-in shower—an ideal setup for guests who prefer to avoid stairs. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms each feature king beds and private baths. The Primary Suite includes a twin daybed with a twin trundle and opens through French doors to the balcony, where Gulf breezes and scenic views create a peaceful place to begin or end the day. A conveniently located laundry room is also situated on the second floor. Down By The Sea is part of the charming Grayton Beach Cottages community, where guests enjoy access to a neighborhood pool for a refreshing swim before or after time on the beach. Past guests consistently praise the home’s location, noting the easy walk to the beach and nearby restaurants and shops, as well as the clean, beautifully decorated interiors and comfortable furnishings. The home sits just steps from the laid-back heart of Grayton Beach, where colorful cottages, live music, and local character define one of 30A’s most beloved coastal villages. Spend an evening enjoying fresh seafood and live tunes at the legendary Red Bar , grab tacos and Gulf views at Chiringo , browse the eclectic art and gifts at Zoo Gallery, or pick up beach gear and coastal style at Tribe Kelley Surf Post . Beyond Grayton Beach, Scenic 30A connects a string of beloved coastal communities, each with its own personality and charm. Nearby Seaside offers iconic pastel architecture, boutique shopping, and a lively town square filled with food trucks and events. WaterColor invites leisurely exploration with its beautiful parks, trails, and waterfront dining, while Blue Mountain Beach is known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic dune landscapes, and local favorites like ice cream shops and casual cafés. Whether you're biking along the scenic path, exploring neighboring beach towns, or simply spending long days by the water, Down By The Sea places you right in the heart of one of South Walton’s most vibrant and memorable stretches of coastline. First Floor:  Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Dining, Kitchen, Bedroom with Queen and Full Bed, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower. Second Floor:  King Primary Bedroom with Daybed + Twin Trundle and Walk-In Shower + Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-in Shower Combo, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry. The community pool is typically heated during fall, holiday weeks, and spring break, but is based on the daily temperature and HOA discretion.
